items.title: US military aircraft leave second UK base
items.summary: The departures come weeks after the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford airbase over a suspected Iran-linked security incident.

items.title: Storms hitting UK at same time led to one of country's wettest days on record
items.summary: Storms Austen and Boelo striking different parts of the UK at the same time contributed to 24 October being one of the wettest days Britain has ever seen.

items.title: Met Police investigate several reports on Russell Brand following his conviction
items.summary: Det Supt Andy Furphy says the force had received "several reports in during the trial and since the trial".

items.title: Pupils at Edinburgh Academy suffered decades of 'dreadful abuse'
items.summary: Pupils at Edinburgh Academy suffered "dreadful abuse" over four decades while the school sought to protect its reputation and ignored complaints, the Scottish Child Abuse Inquiry has found.

items.title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England
items.summary: The government says it is strengthening its guidance for schools in England, which came into force in June.

items.title: At least 12 killed in Bulgaria motorway pile-ups involving dozens of vehicles
items.summary: At least 12 people have been killed in two motorway pile-ups in eastern Bulgaria, the country's health minister said.
